requirements.description: Microsoft Cloud: original definition of the Microsoft Cloud revenue metric (what it includes) and FY2025 disclosed revenue amount and growth rate vs FY2024.

Intelligent Cloud: segment definition and principal components (server products and cloud services; enterprise and partner services) and FY2025 segment revenue, operating income and growth vs FY2024 with units.

Azure: any definition or description of Azure itself and of the reported line Azure and other cloud services, plus the FY2025 disclosed growth rate (34%); check whether any standalone Azure revenue amount is disclosed (do not estimate). Include qualifiers on scope, e.g. Azure and other cloud services vs server products and cloud services.

reason: Plan three source_evidence requirements covering Microsoft Cloud, Intelligent Cloud and Azure definitions and FY2025 metrics, addressing the prior review's gap on Azure's standalone definition.
